```{r}
#| label: setup

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

## Named Storms per Year

```{r}
#| label: plot-storms
storms %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_storms = n_distinct(name)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_storms)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Number of Named Storms per Year",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Number of Storms") +
  theme_minimal()
```
